title: A remittance's interest reported on its claims (AMT I) and paid at the provider level (PLB L6)
assertion: Credited once per line, from the PLB L6: to the claim of its own payer that its reference names, whole or among other identifiers, or shared by the remittance's AMT I netted per claim and its reversals and corrections, exactly when the PLB L6s equal that AMT I and never past what each reports otherwise; a named PLB L6 above its claim's AMT I first pays the remittance's other reported interest. A PLB L6 of zero moves nothing and the reconcile completes. AMT I with no PLB L6 in its check counts nowhere and is shown as reported. A reversal and correction linked as one claim's chain whose AMT I nets to zero add no interest, beside another claim or not; a reversal the payer renumbered, which the loader does not link, still lets its correction's interest count again (a known gap, pinned until the link is built). A PLB L6 in a later remittance naming the claim is credited once

files.description: The original payment of two case lines on one day: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, paid 56.00, and 97110-59 x 2 allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 50.00: BPR02 106.00.

The original reversed (paid -106.00) and the correction C (SYNCCNLED230002), 97110 allowed 100.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00, and 97110-59 allowed 100.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 80.00, with AMT I 5.40, and PLB L6 -5.40 naming C: BPR02 59.40.

paired.835's remittance, which the ledger oracle loads after original.835: The original reversed (paid -106.00) and the correction C (SYNCCNLED230002), 97110 allowed 100.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00, and 97110-59 allowed 100.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 80.00, with AMT I 5.40, and PLB L6 -5.40 naming C: BPR02 59.40.
The bank export: one deposit of 59.40, the paired check, matched by trace number and amount.
As paired.835, beside another patient's claim K (SYNCCNLED230003) paying 150.00 with AMT I 2.00, and one PLB L6 of -7.40 naming nothing: BPR02 211.40.
As unnamed.835, the PLB L6 of -7.40 naming C (SYNCCNLED230002), the net interest of both claims: BPR02 211.40.
As paired.835, the PLB L6's reference carrying CLP01, CLP07 and TRN02 ("SYNPCNLED23001 SYNCCNLED230002 SYNEFTLED23005"): BPR02 59.40.
As paired.835 with no PLB L6: AMT I 5.40 outside the check, BPR02 54.00.

After paired.835: C reversed (paid -160.00, AMT I -5.40) and corrected again (SYNCCNLED230004), 97110 allowed 102.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 82.00, and 97110-59 as before, with AMT I 5.40, and no PLB L6 (the interest nets to zero): BPR02 2.00.
After paired.835: net-zero.835's pair beside K paying 150.00 with AMT I 2.00, and one PLB L6 of -2.00 naming nothing: BPR02 154.00.
After reported-only.835: a later remittance whose PLB L6 of -5.40 names C (SYNCCNLED230002), beside another patient's claim paying 150.00 with no AMT I: BPR02 155.40.
As paired.835 with a second PLB L6 of 0 naming C: BPR02 59.40.

After paired.835, a known gap pinned: C reversed under its own new CLP07 (SYNCCNLED230006) with REF F8 naming C (paid -160.00, AMT I -5.40), which the loader leaves unlinked; its correction (SYNCCNLED230007, REF F8 naming C) paying 97110 2.00 more on an allowed 102.00, AMT I 5.40; K paying 150.00 with AMT I 2.00; one PLB L6 of -2.00 naming nothing: BPR02 154.00.

scenario.packet: submitted for the 97110 line before the adjusted remittance arrives

namedNet.note: the PLB L6 covers C's 5.40 first; the other 2.00 is K's

identifiers.note: named by the CLP07 among the identifiers

reported.note: shown as reported (AMT I), counted nowhere

netZero.note: no new interest entry: the reversal and its correction net to zero

netZeroBeside.note: no new interest on the case lines; K's 2.00 on no case line

zeroL6.note: the PLB L6 of zero moves nothing and every reconcile completes

renumberedReversal.note: a known gap: the unlinked reversal's -5.40 reaches no line, so the correction's 5.40 counts again; the pull request that links a renumbered reversal changes this to no new interest
